name: KitContent - Join Entry (seed v1)
description: One inventory slot of a kit: which item goes there and how many. Created from the kit's Contents step (Create New Join Entry), or filled in by a kit scan.

steps.description: The item placed in one slot of the player's inventory when the kit is granted. If the slot is taken, a matching stack is topped up, otherwise the item goes to the first free slot or is dropped at the player's feet.

fields.label: Item
fields.description: The item blueprint to give; it is built with the blueprint's default name, lore and enchantments.

fields.label: Slot
fields.description: Inventory slot 0-35: 0-8 is the hotbar (left to right), 9-35 the three rows above it. Each slot can hold one entry; the save is refused otherwise.

fields.label: Quantity
fields.description: Stack size in this slot (e.g. 64 arrows, 1 bow). Keep it within the item's stack size.
